text: To the world we livin' in Cars are drivin' with bombs attached to it First born son gets an AK givin' to him They sayin' it's the last days I'm in my living room on the last page of the secret Mine I can't keep it Think out loud I gotta preach it Dreamin' about just how I'm gon' reach it Still tryin' to find the pieces to the puzzle While tryin' to find a reason for the struggle I wonder what lies beneath it Humble I try to keep it Like the features on the Mona Lisa Is he smilin' or frownin'? Is he swimmin' upstream?
